summary.text: Kim Schofield, a Democrat, represents Georgia House District 63; she was elected in 2017 and sworn in on December 15, 2017.

paragraphs.text: Her official biography says the district includes areas of Southeast Atlanta, East Point, College Park, Forest Park and Hapeville, and that she is Secretary of the Urban Affairs Committee.
The biography describes Schofield as a small business owner whose coaching practice is Other People's Potential Coaching.
